Circular Task Analysis – MouseReMoCo¶

Authors: Ayesha Waheed, Charles Sam DEEMUA, Albatoul Ahmad Date: November 2026

Running this notebook runs the three parts of the project in order and exports the results as main.html:

  1. notebooks/01_reproduce_graphics.ipynb: reproduce the graphics
  2. notebooks/02_recompute_statistics.ipynb: recompute the statistics table
  3. notebooks/03_own_data_analysis.ipynb: analysis of our own recording
%matplotlib inline
import os

def run_part(path):
    # Runs one sub-notebook in this kernel, so its plots and tables show up below.
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        print(f"{path} not found yet (the team member has not pushed it).")
    elif os.path.getsize(path) == 0:
        print(f"{path} is empty for now (the team member has not added code yet).")
    else:
        try:
            get_ipython().run_line_magic("run", path)
        except Exception as error:
            print(f"Could not run {path}: {error}")
